snippet.title: Calisthenics VS Cliff Diving | My BIGGEST Fear
snippet.description:
Cliff diving is one of the most dangerous sports in the world. Professional athletes jump from heights of up to 90 feet, reaching speeds of over 50 mph before entering the water with almost perfect precision. Today, I’m stepping completely out of my comfort zone to see if I can learn the basics of cliff diving… despite having a huge fear of heights!

To help me, I trained with professional high diver David Colturi, who took me through a crash course starting from the very basics. From learning proper water entries and eliminating splash to front dives, flips, and climbing higher platforms, every lesson built toward one goal: overcoming my fear and experiencing what it takes to become a cliff diver.

How difficult is cliff diving? How dangerous is high diving? Can a complete beginner learn to dive from 10 meters? And what does it actually feel like standing 90 feet above the water?

Watch until the end to see if I can conquer my fear of heights and gain a whole new respect for one of the most extreme sports on the planet!

snippet.title: What 100 One-Arm Push-Ups A Day Does To Your Body
snippet.description:
What really happens if you do 100 one arm push-ups every day for 7 days?

In this video, Chris Heria takes on a brutal bodyweight challenge to test whether one arm push-ups actually improve real strength, physique, and skill transfer or if it’s just another viral workout.

No weights. No gym. Just pure calisthenics.

Over the course of 7 days, Chris breaks down
• How 100 one arm push-ups a day affects pushing power
• Whether it carries over to advanced skills like planche push-ups
• What changes happen to muscle, endurance, and control
• How hard it really is to stay consistent
• And most importantly… if this challenge is actually worth doing

A lot of people think you need heavy weights to build strength and muscle, but calisthenics works differently. This video shows how leverage, tension, and consistency can push your body to adapt fast using just bodyweight.

If you’re training calisthenics, working toward one arm push-ups, or looking for a simple challenge that actually delivers results, this is one you don’t want to miss.

snippet.title: What Happens If You NEVER Take A REST DAY
snippet.description:
FOLLOW CHRIS HERIA
https://www.instagram.com/chrisheria
https://youtube.com/CHRISHERIA
https://www.tiktok.com/@thechrisheria

Follow THENX on Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/thenx

How many days can you train in a row before your body finally needs to rest? In this video, Chris Heria from THENX travels to Sofia Bulgaria to push his limits and find out exactly how long he can train without taking a single rest day. From heavy calisthenics sessions to gymnastics skills like giants and muscle up to handstand, this experiment was designed to test both strength and recovery in one of the most elite training environments in the world.

Chris has overtrained in the past and knows how dangerous training without rest can be for your body and your progress. This time he wanted to see how far he could really go before his body started to break down. Day 1 began with a full session with THENX athlete Nathan Bosech. By Day 3 he was already hitting upper body, lower body, and advanced skills back to back with no rest at all. By Day 5 he was back at the Legendary Gym refining giants and relearning the muscle up to handstand while completely fatigued. And on Day 6 he found himself at the WSWCF Super Finals, returning to the same stage he competed on twelve years ago, surrounded by some of the strongest athletes in the world.

Every rep and every session pushed his limits a little further. His legs burned, his upper body stayed sore, and the fatigue kept building, but the challenge continued. Even after passing more than 24 hours without training, the experiment was still going. And although he didn’t reach the exact point where his body forced him to stop, he could feel himself getting closer every single day.

If you want to learn how your body responds to training without rest, how much recovery really matters, and how elite athletes manage fatigue while still making progress, this video will give you a real look at what happens when you try to train every day with no break. Follow along as Chris Heria shows the reality of pushing your limits far past what most people ever experience.
